description: This file defines the interface for a vector of integers, including initialization, creation, addition, searching, removal, cleanup, and destruction functions.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Create
methods.description: Creates and initializes an integer vector with a specified number of entries and initial value.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a number to the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds a number in the vector, returning its index or -1 if not found.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes a specific number from the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries
methods.description: Removes unused (probably free or null) entries from the vector.

methods.name: INT_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys the vector and frees associated resources.
